title.rendered: Van Dyk Debuts Video of Their New North American Parts Distribution Center

content.rendered:
Van Dyk Debuts Video of Their New Warehouse

JANUARY 2015 ­- VAN DYK Recycling Solutions has released a video of their new North American Parts Distribution Center in Norwalk, CT. The facility holds over 15,000 different parts, stocked multiple times over for a total of $35 million in spare parts. The video shows a sampling of their vast parts inventory as well as a demo of their state-of–the-art order fulfillment process.

You can view the video at the following link: vdrs.com/warehouse.

VAN DYK’s parts and service department are available 24/7/365 to receive, fulfill, and ship orders. To learn more about the North American Parts Distribution Center or schedule a tour, call the service department at 203-967-1100.
